title: Simple Labor Timer
subtitle: Free, private contraction log
shortDescription: Free, private contraction timing with no ads or subscriptions.
fullDescription: Simple Labor Timer is a local-first timer for recording contraction duration, rhythm, care-team call rules, and urgent warning signs. Data stays on device unless you choose to share an export.

screenshots.timer: Time contractions with one large control.
screenshots.share: Share local summaries with your care team.
